name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 3.7V — WSON
description: Fixed 3.7V LDO linear regulator ICs in surface-mount WSON packages, including WSON-6_1.5x1.5mm_P0.5mm footprints.
selection_hints: Requiring a 3.7V output LDO linear power regulator.
Designing for surface-mount WSON footprints such as WSON-6 (1.5x1.5mm, 0.5mm pitch).
Selecting Tier A symbol entries from KiCad libraries like TLV70237_WSON6.
avoid_when: Output voltages other than 3.7V are required.
Package requirements differ from SMD WSON footprint specifications.
Switching regulators or non-linear power converter topologies are needed.
